title: UCCS Launches Student Access to ChatGPT Edu with Mandatory AI Literacy Gate
snippet: On August 14, 2026, the University of Colorado Colorado Springs (UCCS) launched the student access phase of its ChatGPT Edu initiative [4.1.3]. Crucially, all students, faculty, and staff must complete a Canvas-based 'AI Literacy Foundations' course before gaining access to the secure, institutionally managed tool.

title: Columbia University's aiX Weekly: Shift to AI Literacy Gates and Assessment Reform

snippet: Howard University hosted a multi-day Faculty Bootcamp on Building AI Curriculum Across Disciplines, supported by AWS and the NSF. The intensive design sprint focused on helping instructors from various disciplines responsibly integrate 'agentic AI' into their classrooms and curricula.

title: UNESCO IESALC Releases Special Issue on Generative AI in Teaching and Research
snippet: UNESCO IESALC released Volume 37, Issue 2 of its journal, featuring a thematic dossier titled 'Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) in Teaching and Research: Best Practices, Challenges, and Future Prospects'. title: Beyond the Ban: Why Embracing AI Is Essential for Higher Education
snippet: An op-ed by Kent Ingle argues that higher education must move 'beyond the ban' and train students to master AI as an 'exponential multiplier' for career success. It emphasizes combining technological fluency with unshakeable personal integrity rather than relying on compliance threats.

title: UC Berkeley Math Professor's Op-Ed AI Editing Controversy
snippet: A UC Berkeley math professor, Zvezdelina Stankova, faced scrutiny after admitting to using artificial intelligence to help edit a 2,000-word op-ed criticizing student math deficiencies. The incident highlights the blurring lines of AI use in academic and public writing.
